item.title: Amazon CEO takes aim at Nvidia, Intel, Starlink, more in annual shareholder letter
item.description: Andy Jassy's annual shareholder letter reads something like a diss track to a wide range of competitors as he defends spending $200 billion in capex.

item.title: Poke makes using AI agents as easy as sending a text
item.description: Poke brings AI agents to everyday users via text message by handling tasks and automations without complex setup, apps, or technical know-how.

item.title: AWS boss explains why investing billions in both Anthropic and OpenAI is an OK conflict
item.description: AWS has an ingrained culture of handling competition, he explained, because the cloud giant also competes with its partners.

item.title: Tubi is the first streamer to launch a native app within ChatGPT
item.description: Tubi becomes the first streaming service to offer an app integration within ChatGPT, the AI chatbot that millions of users turn to for answers.

item.title: Astropad’s Workbench reimagines remote desktop for AI agents, not IT support
item.description: Astropad’s Workbench lets users remotely monitor and control AI agents on Mac Minis from iPhone or iPad, with low-latency streaming and mobile access.

item.title: OpenAI releases a new safety blueprint to address the rise in child sexual exploitation
item.description: OpenAI's new Child Safety Blueprint aims to tackle the alarming rise in child sexual exploitation linked to advancements in AI.

item.title: Databricks co-founder wins prestigious ACM award, says ‘AGI is here already’
item.description: Matei Zaharia has won the top honor from the Association for Computing Machinery. Now he's working on AI for research and says AGI is simply misunderstood.

item.description: Save up to $500 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until April 10, 11:59 p.m. PT. Secure your spot at the center of the tech ecosystem. Register today.

item.title: Atlassian launches visual AI tools and third-party agents in Confluence
item.description: Confluence users can now create visual assets within the software in addition to new third-party agents working with Lovable, Replit, and Gamma.

item.title: Google quietly launched an AI dictation app that works offline
item.description: Google's new offline-first dictation app uses Gemma AI models to take on the apps like Wispr Flow.

item.title: I can’t help rooting for tiny open source AI model maker Arcee
item.description: Arcee is a tiny 26-person U.S. startup that built a high-performing, massive, open source LLM. And it's gaining popularity with OpenClaw users.

item.title: Firmus, the ‘Southgate’ AI data center builder backed by Nvidia, hits $5.5B valuation
item.description: Nvidia-backed Asia AI data center provider Firmus has now raised $1.35 billion in six months.

item.title: Intel signs on to Elon Musk’s Terafab chips project
item.description: Intel will join SpaceX and Tesla in an effort to build a new U.S. semiconductor factory in Texas, although the scope of its contributions are unclear.

item.title: Anthropic debuts preview of powerful new AI model Mythos in new cybersecurity initiative
item.description: The new model will be used by a small number of high-profile companies to engage in defensive cybersecurity work.

item.title: Uber is the latest to be won over by Amazon’s AI chips
item.description: Uber is expanding its AWS contract to run more of its ride-sharing features on Amazon's chips. This is a thumb-of-the nose at Oracle and Google.

item.title: Anthropic ups compute deal with Google and Broadcom amid skyrocketing demand
item.description: Anthropic bulked up its compute deal with Google and Broadcom as the company has seen its run-rate revenue surge to $30 billion.

item.title: Google Maps can now write captions for your photos using AI
item.description: Google is rolling out new features to make it easier for users to contribute local knowledge to Maps. Most notably, Gemini can now create captions when users are looking to share a photo or video about a place.
